description: Named NPCs who post contracts each Moon. Phase 4 content; listed here so the names are stable from the first night.

patrons.name: Sister Agathe of the Broken Bell
patrons.reward: Renown, and a line in the finale.

patrons.name: Old Henrik the Fence
patrons.voice: Weighs everything twice. The second time is the price.
patrons.reward: A Market token, and Henrik as patron.

patrons.name: The Man in Grey
patrons.voice: Does not give his name. Knows yours.
patrons.reward: A Sight token, and the next Moon's scenario early.
